text: 어? 이거 나한테 준 거야? 헐, 진짜? 완전 좋아!
difficulty: 놀라움에서 기쁨으로 빠르게 전환, 감탄사 연속
instruct: Read aloud with escalating surprise turning into pure delight — each exclamation more excited than the last.

text: 힘들었지만 끝까지 해냈다는 게 스스로도 대견하네요.
difficulty: 조용하고 내면적인 기쁨, 과하지 않은 만족감
instruct: Read aloud with a quiet sense of personal accomplishment — not loud or boastful, just a calm, satisfied glow.

text: 어머, 이런 것까지 챙겨주시다니! 너무 감사해요, 진짜!
difficulty: 밝고 가벼운 감사, 높은 에너지, 반말+존댓말 혼용
instruct: Read aloud with bright, cheerful gratitude — light and energetic, like receiving an unexpected small gift.

text: 그때 한마디만 더 했으면 달라졌을까요. 자꾸 생각이 나요.
instruct: Read aloud in a quiet, sorrowful tone weighed down by deep regret — slow pace with long pauses between sentences.

text: 도대체 몇 번을 말해야 알아듣는 거야! 이게 말이 돼?
difficulty: 강한 분노, 빠른 템포, 높은 볼륨, 경직된 톤
instruct: Read aloud with intense anger and frustration — loud, fast, and sharp, as if losing patience completely.

text: 에이, 또야? 진짜 매번 이러면 나도 지치지.
difficulty: 짜증, 귀찮음이 섞인 한숨 톤, 중간 강도
instruct: Read aloud with casual, low-key irritation and an exhausted sigh — annoyed but not explosive.

text: 결과가 언제 나오는 거죠? 계속 기다리기만 하니까 미칠 것 같아요.
difficulty: 불안한 톤, 약간 빠르고 불안정한 리듬
instruct: Read aloud in an anxious, restless tone with a slightly unsteady rhythm, as if the speaker can barely contain their nervousness.

text: 기대를 많이 했는데, 결과가 이 정도밖에 안 되다니.
instruct: Read aloud starting with a hint of hope, then let the voice drop into flat disappointment by the end.

text: 주말인데 연락할 사람이 아무도 없네요. 좀 쓸쓸하다.
instruct: Read aloud in a subdued, lonely tone — quiet and hollow, as if talking to an empty room.

text: 그때 그 선택을 안 했더라면 지금 이렇게까지 안 됐을 텐데.
instruct: Read aloud heavy with regret, voice fading toward the end as if the speaker is lost in painful what-ifs.

text: 아무리 설명해도 이해를 못 하시니까 정말 답답해요.
difficulty: 답답함이 축적되는 톤, 한숨 섞인 체념
instruct: Read aloud with mounting frustration and a heavy sigh of exasperation, as if hitting a wall after repeated failed attempts.

text: 하아, 오늘 하루가 정말 길었다. 이제 아무것도 하기 싫어.
instruct: Read aloud in a completely drained, exhausted tone — start with a long weary sigh, then speak slowly with zero energy.

text: 다들 가면서 나한테는 한마디도 안 했더라. 좀 섭섭하네.
difficulty: 서운함, 직접적 분노가 아닌 상처받은 톤
instruct: Read aloud in a quietly hurt tone — not angry, just genuinely disappointed and feeling left out.

text: 네, 알겠습니다. 더 이상 할 말 없습니다.
difficulty: 표면적으로 차분하지만 속으로 부글부글 끓는 억제된 분노
instruct: Read aloud in a tightly controlled, cold tone — the voice is calm but rigid, barely concealing suppressed anger underneath.

text: 이렇게 끝이라니. 허무하다, 정말.
difficulty: 감정이 빠져나간 뒤의 텅 빈 느낌
instruct: Read aloud in a hollow, emptied-out voice — as if all emotion has already been spent and only a shell remains.

text: 좋겠다, 너는. 나도 그런 기회가 한 번이라도 있었으면.
instruct: Read aloud with a mix of envy and longing — the first phrase has a sharp, jealous edge, then the second trails off wistfully.

text: 처음엔 화가 났는데, 이제는 뭐 어쩔 수 없다 싶어요.
instruct: Read aloud starting with a tense, angry edge in the first half, then gradually softening into resigned acceptance.

text: 떨어졌을 줄 알았는데 합격이래요! 심장이 멎을 뻔했어요.
instruct: Read aloud with dread and tension at first, then suddenly burst into relieved, joyful disbelief.

text: 네, 물론이죠. 항상 저만 야근하는 건 당연한 거잖아요.
difficulty: 비꼬는 톤, 표면적 긍정이지만 내면적 불만
instruct: Read aloud with biting sarcasm — the agreement sounds deliberately fake, dripping with passive-aggressive resentment.

text: 떠나는 게 맞는 건 알겠는데, 막상 가려니까 발이 안 떨어져요.
instruct: Read aloud with inner conflict — the first half is rational and resolute, but the second half hesitates and trails off reluctantly.

text: 그 골목 어귀 떡볶이 냄새만 맡으면 아직도 그 시절이 떠올라요.
instruct: Read aloud with warm, wistful nostalgia — a bittersweet reminiscence, gentle and slightly aching.

text: 많이 울었어요. 그런데 이제는 다시 일어나야죠.
instruct: Read aloud starting fragile and tearful, then gathering quiet strength and determination in the second sentence.

text: 뭐, 원래 내 인생이 그렇죠. 기대를 안 하면 실망도 없고.
instruct: Read aloud with a dry, self-mocking chuckle — resigned and detached, as if the speaker has given up caring.

text: 뭐라고요? 그걸 지금 말하는 거예요? 왜 진작 얘기를 안 한 거야!
instruct: Read aloud escalating rapidly from shocked disbelief to furious outrage — each sentence more intense than the last.

text: 정말 미안해요. 일부러 그런 건 아니었는데, 핑계처럼 들리겠죠?
difficulty: 진심 사과 + 변명에 대한 자각, 복합적 어조
instruct: Read aloud with sincere guilt and remorse at first, then shift into an awkward, self-aware tone when acknowledging the excuse.

text: 아 그래요? 별로 관심 없었는데, 어? 근데 이거 좀 재밌는데요?
instruct: Read aloud starting flat and indifferent, then suddenly perking up with genuine curiosity and growing interest.

text: 우와, 진짜 붙었어! 근데 이제 진짜 해내야 하는 건데, 갑자기 무섭다.
difficulty: 합격 기쁨 직후 밀려오는 부담감과 두려움
instruct: Read aloud bursting with joy at first, then quickly transitioning into a quieter, worried tone as the weight of responsibility sinks in.

text: 잘 지내, 진심이야. 나도 이제 내 갈 길 가야지.
difficulty: 슬프지만 의연하게 감정을 다잡는 이별 인사
instruct: Read aloud in a bittersweet farewell — steady and composed on the surface, but with a faint crack of emotion underneath.

text: 햇빛이 눈부셔서 볕이 잘 드는 곳에 빨래를 널었어요.
instruct: Read aloud in a bright, pleasant tone as if describing a sunny day — handle the palatalization of ㄷ to ㅈ before ㅣ naturally.

text: 미닫이문을 닫히게 하지 말고 열어 두세요.
instruct: Read aloud as a gentle instruction — cleanly apply palatalization rules while keeping the tone calm and direct.

text: ㅋㅋ 진짜 웃기다. ㅠㅠ 근데 좀 슬프기도 하네.
instruct: Read aloud in a casual, texting-style tone — vocalize the consonant emoticons as light laughter for ㅋㅋ and a whimpering sound for ㅠㅠ.

text: 고양이가 야옹야옹 울고, 강아지는 멍멍 짖었어요.
instruct: Read aloud in a playful, animated tone as if telling a story to a child — make the animal sounds lively and expressive.

text: 비가 주룩주룩 내리고, 바람이 쌩쌩 불었어요.
instruct: Read aloud in a vivid, atmospheric tone — give the onomatopoeia words a rhythmic, sensory quality that evokes the rain and wind.

text: 이거 완전 갓생 살기 아닌가요? 진짜 갓벽해요.
instruct: Read aloud in an enthusiastic, trendy tone as if chatting with friends — pronounce the slang terms confidently as established words.

text: 가격은 ₩15,000이고 할인율은 20% 적용돼서 ₩12,000이에요.
instruct: Read aloud in a helpful, sales-assistant tone — read currency symbols as their full Korean word and percentages naturally.

text: 해돋이를 보려고 뒤뚱뒤뚱 걸어가다가 넘어질 뻔했어요.
instruct: Read aloud in a lighthearted, self-amused tone as if telling a clumsy morning story — palatalize correctly and give the mimetic word a wobbly rhythm.

text: 아이고, 어머나! 세상에 이런 일이 다 있다니!
instruct: Read aloud with dramatic, exaggerated surprise — each exclamation should have its own distinct emotional peak.

text: 물음표와 느낌표, 쉼표, 마침표를 올바르게 사용하세요.
difficulty: 문장부호 명칭 읽기(물음표, 느낌표, 쉼표, 마침표)
instruct: Read aloud in a clear, instructional tone as if teaching punctuation — pronounce each punctuation mark name distinctly.
